adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a bug in the totalPages calculation. Looking at the diff, line 12 shows `return Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1;`. With user_count=50 and limit=50, this calculates Math.floor(50/50)+1 = 2 pages, when there should only be 1 page. This is an off-by-one error in pagination. The correct formula should use Math.ceil without the +1, or handle the exact-multiple case differently. This would cause the 'next' button to be enabled when it shouldn't be (since showingLast checks currentPage equals totalPages), allowing users to navigate to an empty page.
